Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show two required points: experience with microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker, and Kubernetes; and proficiency with ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM, and Scikit-learn.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
